heuristics.statement: Generic birthday search on the 256-bit output of 11-round Poseidon (8 full + 3 partial). The time_log2=128.0 is the birthday bound for a 256-bit output, requiring ~2^{128} permutation evaluations to find a collision with probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Time estimate is the generic birthday bound. Algebraic techniques could potentially reduce this.
heuristics.extrapolation: Birthday paradox: for an n-bit output, need ~2^{n/2} evaluations. For n=256, this is 2^{128} for probability ~0.63, or 2^{127} for probability 0.39.
heuristics.limitations: This is the generic bound, not an optimized attack. Algebraic structure of Poseidon may allow faster collision finding.
